instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with shallow depth of field. At an outdoor cafe, the man with dark curly hair (R2) in a black t-shirt sits on the left, and the woman with long curly blonde hair (R1) in a black long-sleeve shirt sits on the right of a dark round table. They are in profile, facing each other. Their right elbows rest on the table with hands clasped; the man (R2) leans forward to kiss the back of the woman's (R1) hand, while she smiles warmly at him. Soft, natural daylight illuminates the scene against a blurred background.
